title: Horizon and Compass
author: Petra Almeida
blurb: Yara Pemberton, an archaeologist's estranged child and better digger, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. Then the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help before the concession permits expire.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
